title: Farm animals and their babies
examples: What is a baby goat called?
Can you name the babies of a cow?
What do we call a baby horse?

explain.say: Today we are learning about baby farm animals. We will learn some fun new names.
A baby cow is called a calf. Say calf with me. A baby pig is called a piglet.
A baby sheep is called a lamb. A baby horse is called a foal. These are good names to know.
If you see a baby horse in the field, it is a foal. This is a real farm animal example.
Sometimes people mix up the names for baby animals. Remember to check which animal you see.

items: What kind of animal is it?

explain.say: If you are unsure, look closely at the animal. Does it have wool like a lamb? Or is it small like a chick?

faq.q: What do you call a baby goat?
faq.a: A baby goat is called a kid. This is a common question.
asks: What is the baby of a goat?
Can you tell me the name for a baby goat?

faq.q: Are all baby animals named differently?
faq.a: Most farm animals have a special name for their baby. This helps us learn about nature.
asks: Do all baby animals have special names?
Why do baby animals have different names?

faq.q: What is the difference between a lamb and a baby sheep?
faq.a: A lamb is the specific name for a baby sheep. It is the correct term to use.
asks: Is lamb the same as baby sheep?
What word do we use for a baby sheep?

faq.q: Do the names change as the animals grow?
faq.a: No, the name refers to the baby stage. The animal will just grow into its adult form.
asks: Does a calf stay a calf forever?
When does a calf stop being a calf?

faq.q: What if I see a baby animal I do not know?
faq.a: It is okay to ask an adult for help. You can always look it up or ask a teacher.
asks: What should I do if I see a new baby animal?
Can I name an animal I have never seen?

facts: A calf is a young cow.
A lamb is the baby of a ewe, which is a female sheep.
A foal is a young horse.
A chick is a baby bird, usually from a chicken.

quiz.show: What is a baby pig called?
quiz.why: A piglet is the correct and specific name for a baby pig.
